host_context: Docker on Mac, as reported by project owner; container fingerprints are preserved verbatim and report Linux. Host OS and Docker image ID are not independently established by these files.
scope: 72 per-image/method predictions on 36 inspected synthetic variants from 12 originals. Source/manifest/image hashes, scores, aggregates and breakdowns are checked without another OCR run. Equal extracted fields and aggregate metrics do not imply byte-identical OCR text/confidence or independent accuracy evidence. Timing is not a cross-platform performance benchmark.
